## Summary

Describe the problem and the chosen solution.

## Security and compatibility

Describe destination-policy, credential, protocol, schema, CLI, and backward-compatibility effects. Write `None` when an area is unaffected.

## Verification

List the exact commands and controlled fixtures used to verify the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes.
